# PDFuse

> PDFuse is a Chrome extension that merges, splits and edits PDFs, turns images into PDFs and exports PDF pages as images, inside your browser. Your files are never uploaded, stored on a server, or sent to anyone.

PDFuse is for anyone who handles sensitive documents and does not want to upload them to a website. No signup; setup takes under 2 minutes. PDFuse Pro is sold through ExtensionPay, with payments processed by Stripe. PDFuse contains no analytics, no ads and no tracking.

## Pages

- [Home](https://pdfuse.app/index.md): what PDFuse does and how to install it
- [Privacy policy](https://pdfuse.app/privacy.html): how PDFuse handles your files and data

## Install

- [PDFuse in the Chrome Web Store](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/pdfuse-%E2%80%93-effortless-pdf-s/goidgjhddnkahdillfckdkhcdjdenecj)
